book.name: Hebrews
book.title: Hebrews Iti Fef I Hebrew Sabuw Isah

content: Firis gagamih etei i orot wanawanahimaim God boro narubin, naatu naya’asair sabuw wabihimaim God isan nabow. Bowabow kakafin notawiyen isan siwar nabow sibor na’afusar.
Nati firis ef tata’ane ririm re’ere i so’ob, imih sabuw iyab tefofokar naatu tisisinaf kakaf i karam boro yaten nanub nibaisih.
Anayabin i auman ririmin, imih boro men sabuw akisih hai bowabow kakafin isan sibor nayai’imih, baise i auman ana kakafin isan sibor boro nayai.
Men yait ta i wabin isan taiyuwin erubin firis gagamin emamataramih, baise God akisin ana kokomaim orot erubin firis gagamin emamatar, Aaron rurubin na’atube.
Ef i ta’imon, Keriso men i taiyuwin wabin isan firis gagamin ana efan baimih, baise God akisin Keriso isan eo,

content.text: “O i ayu Natu, ayu boun o Tamat amatar.”
Buk Atamanin wanawanan efan ta’ane eo maiye,
“O i boro firis ana efanamaim inama wanatowan, firis Melkisedek ma’am na’atube.”

content: Jesu tafaramamaim ma’am ana veya, erererey naatu ere maturin auman God isan dogoron tutufin etei yoyoban, naatu ifefeyan, kokok i morobone tiyawas. Anayabin taiyuwin yayare i God itin, imih God ana yoyoban nowar.
Turobe i God Natun, baise biyababanane fanabow ana ef so’ob.
Naatu rurusouw ana maramaim, na sabuw iyab God fanan hibaib hai yawas wanatowan ana tutut matar.
Iti na’atube sinaf, imih God kurereb Firis Gagamin matar, Melkisedek Firis Gagamin ma’am na’atube.
Ayu akok kwanekwan tur moumurih ata kirum firis gagamin isan atao kwatanowar. Baise kaubuna gewas nowar isan i hifokar, anayabin kwa tur naniyan boro men kwanabaimih.

Iti ao anayabin, kwa i marasika kwana baitumatumayah kwamatar, boun i sabuw afa kwatabi’obaibiyih. Baise boro’ika sabuw afa hima tibi’obaibiyi, bay fokarin kwata’ani’aanifunik, kwama kek gidigihibe nun kwatomatom.
Orot yait nun etomatom i kek sosof, kakafin o gewasin hai naniyan men so’ob.
Baise bay mafur i orot baibin gagamih isah, sabuw iyab hibi’a’ait i karam boro kakafin naatu gewasin hairi nakusib.
